title: Haze: what triggers Healing Tempo's fire-rate buff on this build
question: Does Healing Tempo's buff (+35% fire rate, 7 s) appear from Siphon Bullets' steal, Smoke Bomb T3 lifesteal, Vampiric Burst's active lifesteal, or plain Bullet Lifesteal? Item text: 'Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals'.
hypothesis: Prediction from item text: plain Bullet Lifesteal does NOT trigger it; Siphon steal and Smoke T3 are unknown. If no source in this build triggers it, Healing Tempo is the worst 6.4k in the build (model: +236 HP over keeping Healing Booster, 0 damage); if Siphon triggers it, it is the best last buy (+1491 damage in a 20 s fight).

arms.name: tempo_vb
arms.notes: cast i1 0.3 (VB is first active) then fire 5

controls: hardreset between blocks (fresh pawns, factory cooldowns/charges, unlock 7 = all 3 tiers on every ability in BOTH arms)
Same position (fetch 350, aimoff 5.5 3), same enemy bot (Haze), egod default floor
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B (counterbalanced A,B,B,A for the second half)
healreset + mark none around every reset
cast reload 2.5 before each fire block (no auto-reload op)
accuracy 1 0 (body hits only) so every arm hits equally
procedure: per arm: give items; lowhp 50; cast reload 2.5; arm-specific cast; mark <arm>; fire 5 with mods at t=1,2,3,4,5; acclog; lowhp 0

metrics.name: tempo_modifier_present
metrics.how: modifier name from upgrade_healbuff buff in `mods` log / heals csv modifier list after first heal

metrics.name: shots_fired_5s
metrics.how: GunFired count from acclog vs control_no_tempo

decision.rule: If present in >=4/5 trials for an arm, that source triggers Healing Tempo (confirm with shots_fired >= +25% vs control). SUPPORTS keeping Healing Tempo if tempo_siphon or tempo_smoke or tempo_vb triggers; REFUTES (replace with Leech or Superior Duration, see worked example) if none triggers.

limitations: Checkpoint level/ability-tier states cannot be reproduced (unlock sets all tiers; GAPS #2): results are late-game relative comparisons only.
